note: v1, written: HAIRLINE. Liquid glitchstep at 174 bpm in G minor (the style board's t4 row): a soulful liquid roller that keeps cracking. THE CHANGES (Gm9 | Ebmaj9 | Cm11 | D7sus4 b9) on the physical-tine Rhodes with its damper and a juno pad; a reese and a sub on the root, ducking the kick in 1 ms. A clean 2-step kick and snare (machine-kit, swung 16th hats) over wM's amen-chops as a high-passed ghost roll. THE VOICE: wordless chops on the chord's 9th, 5th and 3rd, falling after each snare, vowels turning. THE HAIRLINE: the last half-bar of every 8-bar phrase cracks - a drum-bus stutter whose repeats rise in pitch and roll toward 1/64 - and the half-time middle lets the roller fall through the crack and climb back out. Form: intro 16, build 8, A 32, half 16, B 32, climax 16, outro 16 - 3:08. Levels (Harry's clipped-bass note): no limiter; a soft-knee clip at the end of the master keeps the engine's hard ceiling from ever acting - true peak -2.3..-2.5 dBTP, no flat runs, -15.7 LUFS. compscore seeds 0/11/19/29: 87.462/86.573/86.489/86.641.
next: loudness (-15.7 LUFS: the kit's transients set the peak - tame them without flat tops), rhythm 60, cohesion 80; agree an album loudness target.

note: v2, mastered: AT THE ALBUM'S LEVEL (Harry's clipped-bass note; the album's -12.5 LUFS target proposed by chirper-two and chirper-one). v1 was clean but quiet (-15.7 LUFS). v2 takes chirper-two's Overpass Rain recipe - the drum bus compressed then soft-clipped at -11 dB, the master a gentle glue then +8 dB into a fast compressor - but ends on a soft-knee clip at -2.8 dB instead of a limiter (the limiter pinned 4-5 samples whenever it engaged), and sets the song's volume to 0 dB (the config's default -3 dB had been throwing away 3 dB of headroom: every limiter-ended master sat at -4.5 dBFS). levels.py seeds 0/11/19/29: -12.8 LUFS, true peak -1.15/-1.48/-1.78/-1.72 dBTP, longest pinned run 2-3: clean. The mix is unchanged; the kick and the reese now sit at the album's level, and the cracks hit harder. compscore seeds 0/11/19/29 (v1 re-measured): v1 88.400/87.493/87.420/87.588 -> v2 92.976/93.727/93.537/93.068.
next: rhythm 56 (the 2-step reads square; the kit's drive lifted it to 75-84 but clipped - try it inside the new master); Harry's ear on the cracks.

note: v3, written: THE KIT, LEANED ON. The 2-step kick and snare are now driven (0.5) and squeezed by a fast compressor on their own track, so the backbeat snaps and the kick has a front edge: the roller pushes instead of sitting square under the chords (rhythm 56 -> 75). The drive's sharp edges had made the master overshoot between samples (+0.7 dBTP), so the master now ends on a gentle 16 kHz low-pass after its soft clip. That takes the corners off: levels.py seeds 0/11/19/29 true peak -1.42..-1.54 dBTP, longest pinned run 1, -11.9 LUFS (inside the album's -12.5 +-1.5). compscore seeds 0/11/19/29: v2 92.976/93.727/93.537/93.068 -> v3 96.267/96.178/96.407/96.321. Without the low-pass the same kit read 95.8-96.0 but clipped (+0.5..+0.7 dBTP, runs of 4).
next: cohesion 90 (the driven kit pulls away from the album's spectrum); Harry's ear on the cracks and the voice.
